info.title: API-DocTest-List Airline Flights Baggages-v2-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Baggage Retrieval API provides access to information regarding baggage associated with airline flights. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed baggage data, including weight limits, fees, and special handling requirements for specific flights. Typically utilized by airline operators and travel agencies, this API aids in enhancing customer service and ensuring compliance with airline policies. It enables quick lookups for baggage-related queries, facilitating a seamless travel experience for passengers.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed baggage information associated with specific flights, including baggage status, dimensions, and weight limits.
